messages:
Mike: Quick heads-up — ran the full replay harness against H100 (driver 535.86, CUDA 12.1) and A100 (driver 525.85, CUDA 11.8) to compare real traffic vs synthetic batching. Unexpected latency spike on H100 at tail percentiles.
Lia: Spike where exactly? p99 or p99.9?
Mike: p95 ~ same, p99 starts diverging, p99.9 ~ 2.5x on H100 for long-context flows with KV cache warm.
Raj: Interesting. Did the kernel selector pick different matmul kernels? We saw selector heuristics change between 535 and 525 before.
Mike: Yeah, profiler shows a different GEMM path for the same model/seq_len when run under the H100 image + 535 driver. nvprof log snippet: `selected kernel: cuBLASLt_algo_chooselut::Algo5` vs on A100 `Algo3`.
Dena: Could be that cuBLASLt heuristics changed, or our kernel-selector fallback threshold (`--kernel-threshold`) is being ignored due to env flags. Did you set `CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG`?
Mike: No, default. I re-ran with `CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8` and p99 improved by ~10% but still worse than A100.
Sarah: Do we have parity between container images? Which images were used on each GPU?
Mike: H100: `redwood/rt:2026-03-01-h100rc`, A100: `redwood/rt:2026-02-18-a100-prod`. There are kernel flag diffs in `/etc/nvidia/driver.conf` (pmode and persistence).
Lia: That could explain behavior. We should lock image + driver + CUDA + kernel flags for apples-to-apples. Proposal: expand CI matrix to include (gpu, driver, cuda, image, kernel-flags) as explicit dims.
Raj: Agreed. Also check our batching heuristic: replay harness uses exact timestamps so batching is realistic; synthetic load uses batch-by-latency binning which may push different batch sizes. We should run synthetic with `--replay-batching=true` to mimic real.
Mike: Repro steps I used (paste):
```bash
# run replay harness with nvprof trace and specific envs
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ./run_replay.sh --trace nvprof --model gpt-xx --sequence 2048 \
  --kv-cache warm --concurrency 16 --replay-batching true \
  env CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8" LD_PRELOAD=/opt/nvidia/lib/libnvidia-ml.so \
  IMAGE=redwood/rt:2026-03-01-h100rc
```
Dena: Nice. Can you also paste the small perf summary?
Mike: Perf summary (p95/p99/p99.9, mean tokens/sec): H100 (535/12.1): 128ms / 320ms / 720ms, 2100 tok/s. A100 (525/11.8): 120ms / 140ms / 290ms, 2400 tok/s.
Sarah: That's a big delta at p99.9. Could be kernel fusion/regression or power gating on H100 box. Any dmesg / nvidia-smi anomalies?
Mike: nvidia-smi stable, no thermal throttling. dmesg showed a warning about `kernel: KERNEL_STACKDEPOT: info` on one run — might be noise.
Raj: We should run `nsys` for a full timeline and capture cuBLASLt decision logs. Also dump the kernel selector decision table. Add a small patch to runtime to force the same kernel path for a run to confirm cause.
Lia: Action items: 1) Mike -> run nsight timeline on H100 with replay, upload traces. 2) Raj -> add runtime flag `--force-kernel-path=<algo>` to force cuBLASLt path and re-run. 3) Dena -> create env-parity checklist doc with exact image/driver/cuda/kernel-flags combos and a tiny script to apply flags. 4) Sarah -> check scheduling governor / BIOS power settings on H100 hosts.
perf-bot: Automated note: created perf ticket PERF-894, assigned to @Mike and @Raj, priority P2.
Mike: Started nsight capture (tradeoff: overhead ~5%). Will upload link in thread in ~30m.
Dena: For the env-checklist, recommend this canonical set (strings): `["A100","driver:525.85","cuda:11.8","image:redwood/rt:2026-02-18-a100-prod","kernel-flags:pmode=on"]` and equivalent for H100. Keep in repo `infra/loadtest/matrices/`.
Raj: Small note on batching heuristics — our dynamic batcher uses `batch_delay_ms` and `max_batch_size`. The replay harness historically sets `batch_delay_ms=5`. Try `batch_delay_ms=2` to see if smaller delay reduces p99.9 on H100 (maybe different latency distribution).
Lia: If we see kernel selection flip-flops across driver versions, we need to pin a cuBLASLt commit in the runtime's compatibility table and add an acceptance test in CI that validates selected algorithm for a single synthetic trace.
Sarah: Also consider adding a 'kv-warm' microbenchmark that systematically toggles KV cache sizes and measures kernel path decisions — smaller KV size could change matmul dims and lead to different algo choices.
Mike: Good idea. I'll add microbenchmark and attach results. Uploading nsight link now: https://artifacts.redwood/perf/1845612345/nsight_h100_trace.zip :thumbsup:
Dena: I'll draft the env-parity checklist PR after lunch. Putting TODOs in the ticket.
Raj: I'll prototype `--force-kernel-path` flag today and try forcing Algo3 on H100 to confirm perf delta.
Lia: Great. Keep this thread for traces and quick triage. If anyone notices config drift on the CI images, ping infra.
Mike: Thanks all — will report back after forced-kernel run. :rocket:
